unresolved: "If you might be vulnerable" never says vulnerable to what. The paragraphs mean prone to mania, psychosis or paranoia from drugs that mess with what's real (the person's own reactions, family history, a bad environment or mindset). In an inner child guide most readers will read "vulnerable" as emotionally vulnerable, so the reader who has this risk is not told it is theirs and the reader who doesn't cannot tell to skip. Better: "If you might be prone to mania or psychosis".
